optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Software Engineer, Mine Fleet Dispatch System

professionalSummary.text: Experienced dispatch software engineer with a proven track record of delivering algorithm and interface solutions for mine fleet operations in compliance with company standards.
professionalSummary.witness: Dispatch software engineer at a mining company from 2021 to 2025, delivering algorithm and interface work for the fleet dispatch system against the mine operations specialists' specifications under the dispatch software standard.

professionalSummary.text: Managed on-call responsibilities across three control rooms, handling over fifty night calls including nine stopped-fleet incidents.
professionalSummary.witness: Carried the pager on the dispatch on-call rota for the whole four years across the three control rooms; the on-call log lists fifty-two night calls under my name, nine of them stopped-fleet incidents, each with the time to restore and the control room's sign-off that the fleet was moving again.

professionalSummary.text: Validated every change through the mine simulator, maintaining detailed simulator records and counter-signatures.
professionalSummary.witness: Every change of mine went through the mine simulator before review, with the simulator record filed against the change and countersigned by a second engineer.

professionalSummary.text: Ensured all changes passed dispatch software review and received lead approval, with clear responsibility documentation.
professionalSummary.witness: Changes went through dispatch software review and out on the dispatch software lead's approval, which the change record shows next to the checks that were mine.

professionalSummary.text: Documented written boundaries and hand-over notes for every change, clarifying scope and responsibilities.
professionalSummary.witness: Behind every change there is a boundary and hand-over note in the change record's closure section, stating what the change does not cover.
